sample.identity: source-file digest plus physical row offset
sample.label: clk
sample.label_check: Validate clk and, when supplied, nonclk complement consistency. Reject/count invalid labels; never invent them.
sample.duplicate_policy: Preserve raw rows by default. Coarse user/ad/time equality does not prove duplicate impressions; any duplicate removal policy must be justified and frozen before search.
sample.class_rebalancing: baseline unweighted binary cross entropy; altered objectives are explicit candidate interventions, evaluated on original prevalence

split.basis: advertising impression time, never random row ordering
split.calendar_dates: materialize from verified contiguous exposure dates; do not assume dates from unrelated Taobao datasets
split.intervals: half-open local-day intervals; save corresponding UTC epoch boundaries
split.user_overlap: allowed across chronological partitions; each impression appears exactly once
split.changes: only before formal search, with recorded reasons and a new frozen version

semantic_checks: pv is a page-view behavior, not the advertising clk label
buy is an observed past purchase, not the prediction target
there is no historical item/adgroup identifier in this behavior source
history.strict_visibility: event_time < impression_time; exclude all ties when finer ordering is unavailable
history.warmup: Use supplied pre-exposure behavior logs, including days before the first training day.
history.online_validation_and_test: Earlier behavior-log events may update forward-pass history; no held-out clk labels update weights or target statistics.
history.deduplication: Do not collapse category/brand/type/time coincidences into one event; missing item identity can conceal distinct real events.
history.derived_identity: Category-brand crosses or hashes may be modeled as derived features, but must never be presented as recovered true item IDs.
history.missing_values: Keep explicit missing/unknown states. Do not discard an entire user for an unrelated missing past field.
history.supply_limit_policy: Calibrate and freeze a common visible-event budget before search. Compression uses the same supplied causal events; changes to event supply require a matched information-budget control.
history.target_labels: Do not synthesize ad clicks or exposures from behavioral categories or future events.

feature_fitting.vocabulary_and_scaling: Fit mappings, rare thresholds, imputation statistics and normalization on training exposures and their permissible past histories only; validation/test use frozen mappings or a predeclared hash.
feature_fitting.shared_namespaces: Audit category/brand alignment between current ads and behavior logs before sharing embeddings.
feature_fitting.causal_counts: Behavior counts and temporal features use only events before each impression.
feature_fitting.learned_pretraining: Training/auxiliary objectives may use training examples and their permissible histories only, not the later validation/test behavior stream.
feature_fitting.static_snapshots: Record provenance and as-of assumptions for publisher-supplied user/ad attributes. Exclude fields shown to use future outcomes; never mark an undocumented snapshot as verified point-in-time data.
feature_fitting.readiness: Resolve and record the information-availability contract before freezing; unknown availability stays explicit.

prediction.output: one finite click probability in [0,1] per fixed impression ID
prediction.alignment: exact sample coverage, no dropped difficult rows or duplicated predictions

primary.name: ROC-AUC
primary.scope: all validation impressions at natural prevalence

scoring.invalidity: Nonfinite/out-of-range probabilities, mismatched IDs, or single-class evaluation are invalid results, not substituted scores.
scoring.validation_labels: host scorer may use them for validation metrics and model selection; never fit features or update learned weights with them
scoring.test_labels: host only, released solely into closed assessment output after source/config/selection freeze

shared: declared training recipe or compute budget
controls.capacity: Report dense/embedding parameter counts separately and use matched capacity/compute controls for the claimed mechanism.
controls.cost: Record preprocessing, training, diagnostics, failures, GPU allocation and inference. State batch size, precision, hardware, warmup, cache use and candidate-specific offline work.
controls.cost_comparison: Report both matched-recipe contrasts and actual quality-cost relationships; extra parameters or examples are not silently attributed to a mechanism.

acceptance_checks: all eight exposure days exist and each scored partition has both classes
clk/nonclk are absent from model feature tensors
with a frozen feature mapping, changing future behavior leaves a past exposure's features unchanged
all used behavior timestamps are strictly less than the exposure timestamp
validation/test labels are absent from feature fitting and training losses; at fixed seed/configuration/step count, changing them cannot change fitted transforms or training gradients
validation labels influence checkpoint/model selection or early stopping only through declared validation feedback; test labels cannot influence any selection or training decision
missing fields and empty histories have finite documented model behavior
preprocessing and model predictions agree on namespace, masks, sample identity and feature order
small-data scorer agrees with an independent trusted implementation
resume does not duplicate accepted experiments or drop failed costs
